input.summary: Insert standard Vendor insurance covenant in Miscellaneous
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement carries no insurance covenant even though Commerce One's personnel work in our hosted environment and its MarketSite service handles our Customers' transaction data, so we have inserted our standard coverages. Fallback: E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M. Please renumber the following clause accordingly.

ops.text: 14.9A Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Commerce One shall provide certificates of insurance on Corio's request.

input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.3 addresses survival but not exit: we have added transition assistance for up to six months at then-current rates plus return of our and our Customers' data in machine-readable form within 30 days and certified deletion thereafter. Fallback: 90 days of transition assistance with data export within 30 days.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return to Corio all Corio and Customer data in Commerce One's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.
